description: Find the closest available drivers to a location using live fleet GPS. Give a target as an airport code (LHR, LGW, STN, LTN, LCY, EDI, SOU, BHX, MAN), a UK postcode, or lat+lng. Returns the nearest available cars (online, not on a job) with straight-line distance and a rough drive ETA. Set min_pax to require a vehicle size. Customers and partner agents get an availability view only — car type (Saloon / People Carrier / 8 Seater, executive flag), seats and a rough ETA rounded to 5 minutes for up to 5 cars, plus a per-car-type summary; NO driver name, vehicle, plate, position, distance or fleet size (driver details are shared only after a booking is confirmed). Staff see the full detail and can include busy drivers.

include_on_job.description: Also include drivers currently on a job (default false = available only).

min_pax.description: Only vehicles seating at least this many passengers.

postcode.description: UK postcode, e.g. "SW1A 1AA", or just the district, e.g. "SL4".

name: find_nearest_drivers
title: Find Nearest Drivers
